_comment: Ground truth for tests/fixtures/nrl_pur1011567.pdf (NRL tender PUR1011567, 67 pages, digital text layer, no PDF bookmarks). Pages are 1-based PHYSICAL page indices; printed 'Page X of 67' matches physical here (offset 0). Verified by hand against the PDF on 2026-10-15. Do NOT edit to make a test pass.

targets._comment: The five labels the business asked for. This is a GeM supply tender: SOR, SCC and Technical Specifications are Annexures 19/20/21 and are listed on p15 under 'Annexures Not Applicable for this Tender'. They are absent from the body, so they resolve to null with status not_applicable - that is the correct answer, not a failure, and must not trigger the LLM fallback.

_flat_comment: Two views of the same tree. flat_inclusive: a parent's range covers its children (D = 14-67, Annexure 2 = 18-23). flat_exclusive: a parent's range stops where its first child starts (D = 14-15, Annexure 2 = 18-18). Leaves are identical in both. The pipeline must emit both; tests compare both.

tree_levels._comment: level = 2 + number of dots in the annexure id. Every annexure is a descendant of D. Annexure 7.2 / 7.2.1 have no 'Annexure 7' parent (7.1 is Not Applicable and 7 is not listed): they keep their nominal levels 3 / 4 and attach to D directly. This is normal tender numbering, not an error.
